name: AK Turnip 1.13
description: AK Turnip 1.13: ir3 absolute subgroupShuffle no longer always becomes a waterfall loop (uniform index -> single movs broadcast, id+k / id-k / id^k -> single shfl; hit heavily by Switch emulators translating SHFL); WAIT_ANY on several timeline semaphores no longer busy-spins a CPU core on KGSL; fixed a per-submit KGSL command-object leak, a NULL deref/OOB read in kgsl_syncobj_wait_any, submit_mutex deadlocks on submit error paths, a pipeline-cache use-after-free and reference leak on graphics pipeline compile failure (FAIL_ON_PIPELINE_COMPILE_REQUIRED), an autotune RP-history use-after-free race, BO leaks on AHB/perf-query error paths, A8XX LRZ fast-clear metadata offsets with concurrent binning; ir3 UBO range merging and rematerializable spill fixes; upstream query, texel-buffer, descriptor-pool, heapUsage and KGSL fd fixes. Built with platform-sdk-version=33.
author: aydar
